sections.heading: Methods
sections.text: Particle size was measured by transmission electron microscopy on the as-prepared sample.

sections.heading: Results
sections.text: TEM analysis showed an average particle diameter of 18 nm for the as-prepared sample. The size distribution was obtained from measurements of the imaged particles.

sections.heading: Results
sections.text: The sample exhibited a saturation magnetization of 42 emu/g at room temperature.
